apps.name: Uptime Kuma
apps.compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime-kuma:/app/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  uptime-kuma:

apps.name: Gitea
apps.compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    container_name: gitea
    environment:
      - USER_UID=1000
      - USER_GID=1000
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3000"
      - "${SSH_PORT}:22"
    volumes:
      - gitea:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  gitea:

apps.name: n8n
apps.description: Workflow automation with a fair-code license.
apps.compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    container_name: n8n
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5678"
    volumes:
      - n8n:/home/node/.n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  n8n:

apps.name: Vaultwarden
apps.compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - vaultwarden:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  vaultwarden:

apps.name: code-server
apps.description: VS Code in the browser, running on your server.
apps.compose:
services:
  code-server:
    image: codercom/code-server:latest
    container_name: code-server
    environment:
      - PASSWORD=${PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - code-server:/home/coder
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  code-server:

apps.name: Dozzle
apps.description: Real-time log viewer for Docker containers.
apps.compose:
services:
  dozzle:
    image: amir20/dozzle:latest
    container_name: dozzle
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    restart: unless-stopped

apps.name: IT-Tools
apps.description: Handy online tools for developers (encoders, generators…).
apps.compose:
services:
  it-tools:
    image: corentinth/it-tools:latest
    container_name: it-tools
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:80"
    restart: unless-stopped

apps.name: pgAdmin
apps.description: Web UI to manage PostgreSQL databases.
apps.compose:
services:
  pgadmin:
    image: dpage/pgadmin4:latest
    container_name: pgadmin
    environment:
      - PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL=${EMAIL}
      - PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=${PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - pgadmin:/var/lib/pgadmin
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  pgadmin:

apps.name: Portainer
apps.description: Container management UI (the one you're replacing 😉).
apps.compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    container_name: portainer
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:9000"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - portainer:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  portainer:

apps.name: Homepage
apps.description: A modern, fully static start page / dashboard.
apps.compose:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    container_name: homepage
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:3000"
    volumes:
      - homepage:/app/config
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  homepage:

apps.name: whoami
apps.description: Tiny test container that echoes request info. Great for a quick try.
apps.compose:
services:
  whoami:
    image: traefik/whoami:latest
    container_name: whoami
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:80"
    restart: unless-stopped
